fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects when a user manipulates with Firmward Password on MacOS. NOTE - this command has been disabled on silicon-based apple computers.
fields.name: Suspicious MacOS Firmware Activity
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="osx" and (tgt.process.image.path="/usr/sbin/firmwarepasswd" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "setpasswd" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "full" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "delete" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "check")))
